item.title: ‘We’re talking about people’s lives:’ California lawmakers grill DMV director on deadly failures
item.description: The state Senate's hearing on driving laws was spurred by a CalMatters investigation into California's approach to deadly drivers.

item.title: How to fix the contamination in the Tijuana River? A new report lays out the multi-step solution
item.description: The Tijuana River in San Diego has sickened surfers, swimmers and Navy SEALS for decades. A new report explores ways to clean it up.

item.title: ¿Cómo solucionar la contaminación del río Tijuana? Un nuevo informe propone varios pasos
item.description: La contaminación en el río Tijuana en San Diego ha enfermado a surfistas, nadadores y miembros de los Navy SEALs durante décadas. Un nuevo informe explora maneras de limpiarlo.

item.title: Condado de San Diego demanda a ICE por bloquear inspección sanitaria en centro de detención
item.description: El condado de San Diego está demandando a la administración Trump por impedir que funcionarios inspeccionen los centros de detención de ICE. Se han recibido informes alarmantes sobre las condiciones inseguras en los centros.

item.title: I crossed the border alone as a child. Here’s what I learned about family separation
item.description: To understand what mass deportations are really about, we must examine the systems that have long separated families of color across the Americas.

item.title: 10 projects from Newsom’s mental health bond were supposed to open in 2025. That didn’t happen
item.description: Projects that are supposed to offer mental health and substance use care to foster youth, new mothers, unhoused people and other vulnerable Californians have been delayed or cancelled.

item.title: ‘A Top Gun pilot like no other’: The story behind a 100-year-old veteran’s surprise Medal of Honor
item.description: Korean War pilot Royce Williams battled Russian jets in the longest historic dogfight, kept secret for half a century. At 100 years old, he earned the Medal of Honor.

item.title: As gas prices soar, California’s new carbon emission rules prompt a war of words
item.description: With some California gas prices topping $5 a gallon, anything that pushes prices even higher, like emissions crackdowns, will become a political football.

item.description: I’m CalMatters reporter Ryan Sabalow, and I’m pinch hitting for Lynn today. As Gov. item.title: Crucé la frontera sola de niña. Esto es lo que aprendí sobre la separación familiar.
item.description: Para entender de qué se tratan realmente las deportaciones masivas, debemos examinar los sistemas que durante mucho tiempo han separado a las familias de color en todo el continente americano.
